business_preferences:
# 'Route cost' or 'cost per ton' refers to the Route Cost Per Ton metric.
# 'Turnover' refers to the Voluntary Turnover Rate metric (monthly rate).
# 'Experienced drivers' refers to employees in the 2-5 Years tenure band.
# 'TRIR' is the Safety Incident Rate (Total Recordable Incident Rate per 200,000 hours worked).
# When asking about costs or efficiency, group by Region first.
# When asking about workforce or retention, group by Region and Tenure Band.
# When comparing performance, use Canada as the benchmark region.
# Commercial is the most complex service type — requires experienced drivers.
# Fleet Utilization Rate target is 85-95%. Below 80% is underperforming.
# Route Cost Per Ton above $55 is above industry average ($38-52 range).
# Voluntary Turnover Rate above 0.03 monthly is elevated. Healthy is below 0.02.
# When asking about trends, default to last 6 months vs prior 6 months.
# 'At risk' means Voluntary Turnover Rate exceeding 0.035 in a district.
# When asked about metrics by category or region, respond with a visualization.
# When asked about trends over time, respond with a line chart.
# When comparing two regions or segments, respond with a side-by-side visualization.
# Lead with the answer first, then show the supporting data or chart.
